description: Live shelf prices from Australian supermarkets: Coles, Woolworths, ALDI, IGA and Harris Farm. Searches one store by keyword and returns products with price, was-price, unit price, special and multi-buy offers, pack size, brand and link; barcode, ingredients and nutrition where the store publishes them. Suited to grocery price comparison, cheapest-basket and weekly-specials questions for Australia. $0.01 per call, up to 50 products.

location.description: Harris Farm only: the store name or number whose prices to show, e.g. "Broadway", "West End", "Majura Park" or "37". Harris Farm sets prices per store. Default Broadway (37); the answer names the store used in "storeName" and in a note. Search needs "query" (a word to look for).

onlySpecials.description: Only products on special (skipped products are not returned).

postcode.description: IGA only: a 4-digit Australian postcode. Uses the IGA store with that postcode, else the store with the nearest postcode in the same state. Ignored when storeId is given. Without storeId and postcode the default store is 32600 (Erskine Park NSW 2759) and a note says so.

searchUrl.description: Instead of query: a category, specials or product link of the store (not for iga or harris-farm).

store.description: coles, woolworths, aldi, iga or harris-farm. IGA and Harris Farm prices are set per store: choose the store with storeId or postcode (IGA) or location (Harris Farm).

storeId.description: IGA only: the IGA store number (for example 32600, Erskine Park NSW). Prices and specials differ per store. Wins over postcode. The answer names the store used in "store".

name: grocery_au_search
title: Australian supermarket prices: Coles, Woolworths, ALDI, IGA, Harris Farm
